recent_articles.title: Italy Heatwave: Italy on red alert as France, Portugal beat hottest May day record - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Italy**, **Portugal**, and **France** issued warnings as a heatwave brought record-breaking temperatures to Europe.  The mercury peaked at 40.3C in **Portugal**, surpassing the previous record of 40C from May 2001, while **Britain** and **France** reported their hottest-ever May days. The heatwave has caused hospitalisations in **Portugal** and deaths attributed to drowning accidents in both **Britain** and **France**.  The **European meteorological agency** warned that the heatwave is likely to last into early June.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka CM Siddaramaiah announces decision to step down at breakfast meeting with Ministers - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: A.P. Ministers review excise reforms, liquor policy - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: BJP alleges ‘procurement conspiracy’, says farmers forced to sell below MSP - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: BJP, Congress attack SP over party spokesperson’s remark on Brahmins; FIR registered - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Assam swearing-in LIVE: Himanta Biswa Sarma takes oath as Assam CM; Four MLAs sworn in as Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma** was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Assam for a second consecutive term on Tuesday, May 2, 2026. **Governor Lakshman Prasad Acharya** administered the oath of office at a ceremony held at the Veterinary Ground in Guwahati. recent_articles.title: Siddaramaiah launches counter-attack, accuses Modi of destroying dignity of Prime Minister’s post - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Govt. to bring reforms in AYUSH sector to enhance quality: Health Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The State government of Andhra Pradesh** is implementing reforms in the AYUSH sector to enhance healthcare services and combat the distribution of fake drugs. **Minister for Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare Satya Kumar Yadav** announced the establishment of three committees – an expert committee, a stakeholders committee, and a technical committee – to develop new guidelines. The committees will consult experts, gather public feedback, and study best practices from other states like Kerala, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu before submitting their recommendations.  The aim is to strengthen the regulatory framework for AYUSH clinics and hospitals, ensuring all practitioners are qualified and services meet national standards.

recent_articles.title: Telangana BJP distances itself from POCSO case against Bandi Sanjay’s son, calls it legal issue - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: In Kerala, nearly half of Congress’ MLAs-elect are young faces - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** emerged victorious in the recent Kerala Assembly elections, with a significant number of young leaders securing victory. These newly elected representatives, who are significantly younger than the average age of senior Congress leaders in the state, attribute their success to factors such as organizational preparedness, a favorable political climate, and the public's dissatisfaction with the ruling Left Democratic Front (LDF) government. The party is optimistic about the future leadership of these young candidates, predicting they will guide the party for at least the next 15 years.

recent_articles.title: Telangana BJP chief’s special memento for Modi - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Hantavirus outbreak: Cruise ship passengers start disembarking in Spain, all to be checked for symptoms - The Times of India

The outbreak has resulted in three deaths and five confirmed cases of hantavirus infection, while authorities are investigating the source of the virus and its transmission on board.

recent_articles.title: Hantavirus may've spread to remote island - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **WHO** director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, along with **Spain** health minister Monica Garcia and interior minister Fernando Grande-Marlaska, are coordinating the disembarkation of the Dutch-flagged cruise ship MV Hondius after two suspected hantavirus cases emerged thousands of miles apart. recent_articles.title: Nitish Kumar’s son Nishant Kumar may join Bihar cabinet on May 7 - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: BJP-led NDA scores hat-trick in Assam - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Kerala Assembly elections: NDA heavyweights set for campaign blitz across State - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Union Ministers** and national leaders are leading a series of high-profile roadshows and public rallies across Kerala for **BJP-led NDA candidates**.  **Smriti Irani**, **Tejasvi Surya**, and other senior party figures are participating in the campaign blitz, focusing on key constituencies. **J.P. Nadda**, **Kiren Rijiju**, and **Durga Das Uikey** are also actively involved in supporting local candidates. The campaign aims to bolster support for the alliance's regional aspirations.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka seeks public feedback on draft policy for students’ digital use - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Karnataka Health Department** has released a draft policy on responsible digital use among students for public feedback. The policy, developed in collaboration with **NIMHANS** and other stakeholders, aims to address concerns about excessive and unsafe digital device use by children.  Students, parents, and the general public are invited to submit their comments via email until April 15th. The draft emphasizes training parents and teachers to reduce excessive mobile phone use among children and promoting digital well-being through integrated curriculum programs.
